brief: Distinguish a planned goal from an emergency reserve and compare complete purchase costs before funding a new goal.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Protect two saving purposes"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Protege dos propósitos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Proteja dois propósitos"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish a planned goal from an emergency reserve and compare complete purchase costs before funding a new goal.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Giving the same money two purposes does not double it. Keep the goal and the emergency reserve distinct.
instruction.misconception: Counting the same reserved money as available for multiple different purposes.
instruction.numeracy_support: Recall percentage reductions, mandatory charges and equal contributions.

evidence.reasoning: The discount and mandatory delivery both affect the final total.
The unexpected interruption fits the emergency purpose.
Only money assigned to this goal reduces its remaining gap.
The required charge changes which offer has the lower total.
Using the reserve changes its balance and the next contribution plan.
The contributions fill the goal gap without reusing a separate reserve.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.

en-US.line: Giving the same money two purposes does not double it. Keep the goal and the emergency reserve distinct.
